sources.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna August ChatGPT update (bound Discovery source)
sources.role: Bound OpenAI first-party product and Deployment Safety source record; product, access, safety, and reliability statements remain OpenAI-attributed.

claims.text: OpenAI describes an August 6 ChatGPT update in which GPT-5.6 Sol is updated for Plus and Pro users with more focused answers and improved factual reliability, and an effort slider lets users choose how much thought is used for a response.

OpenAI says the same Sol model powers Instant and deeper reasoning experiences for Plus and Pro users, while GPT-5.6 Luna becomes the default model for Free and Go users with unlimited text chats and a Think button subject to the stated rollout and guardrails.
The OpenAI Deployment Safety Hub distinguishes the August versions released on August 6 from the July versions that remain in use in Codex and ChatGPT Work.
The bound OpenAI pages describe the August update as a ChatGPT product and deployment-safety change, not the original GPT-5.6 model launch.
The OpenAI pages' product, reliability, safety-capability, rollout, and evaluation-protocol descriptions are OpenAI-attributed claims.

limitations.text: OpenAI explicitly says the optimized Sol version in this release is available only in the Chat experience and that the GPT-5.6 Sol version powering ChatGPT Work and Codex is not changed by the release.

The internal evaluation figures and capability assessments are not independently reproduced here; OpenAI notes that policies, graders, datasets, and measurement details evolve and earlier system-card scores may not be directly comparable.

targets.target: distinguish the August 6 ChatGPT update from the original GPT-5.6 launch;
targets.finding: The bound OpenAI product and safety pages identify a distinct August 6 ChatGPT update and explicitly distinguish it from the original GPT-5.6 launch.

targets.target: preserve the explicit Work/Codex unchanged boundary;
targets.finding: The Deployment Safety source preserves the explicit boundary that the GPT-5.6 Sol version powering ChatGPT Work and Codex is unchanged.
Product, reliability, safety, and evaluation statements are retained as OpenAI-attributed claims rather than independent measurements.
